Title: Data Folder Project Wiki Policy
Content: The repository Data/Memories folder is the project memory wiki for MemorySmith itself. Application defaults should continue pointing MemorySmith:DataPath to ../Data/Memories. Tests that need real project memory data should copy this folder into a temp directory and exercise the copy, so the source wiki remains stable while still acting as the application testbase. Purpose-built records tagged test-fixture provide deterministic search and context-pack graph cases without relying only on incidental product documentation.
